channel.title: Dry Powder Dispatch — Explainers
channel.description: Follow the capital. Find the frontier. Explainers and frameworks on venture capital and startup money flow.

item.title: Anthropic priced above its range. Most big 2026 listings still trade below issue.
item.description: The deal raised $81.34 billion on 18 November. Of the 53 US IPOs of $1 billion or more this year, 37 sat under their issue price at the 19 November close.

item.title: The Fed hiked in September and held in October, with two votes to hike again.
item.description: The target range sits at 3.75% to 4%. The next meeting runs 8 and 9 December.

item.title: October venture hit $59 billion. Seven billion-dollar rounds took over 40% of it.
item.description: Q3 had a record 27 rounds of $1 billion or more. The dollar totals keep rising and the list of companies behind them keeps shrinking.

item.title: Funds closed this month: Norwest raised $4 billion and a lot of small funds closed beside it
item.description: Two weeks of fund announcements show a barbell: a few very large vehicles and many solo and specialist funds under $100 million.

item.title: Europe had its best quarter in four years. Four rounds made up close to 40% of it.
item.description: Crunchbase counts $25 billion for Q3. Tech.eu counts €27.8 billion. November added a $5 billion drug-discovery round and a run of defence deals.

item.title: India: more money, fewer deals, fewer investors
item.description: Indian tech startups raised $2.2 billion in Q3, up 5%. Deal count fell 13% and active investors fell 24%.

item.title: MENA startups raised $1.65 billion in Q3. Saudi Arabia led, and fewer companies took the money.
item.description: Funding doubled on Q2 and fell 63% on Q3 2025. Nine-month deal count is down a third.

item.title: Exits without an IPO: tenders, secondaries and the funds that sell
item.description: Record secondary volume and busy tender calendars carry most of the liquidity load while the IPO window serves a handful of names.

item.title: How money crosses borders in 2026: UPI links, stablecoin rules and the cost of a remittance
item.description: The US finalised its stablecoin rule on 21 October. UPI now runs in nine countries. Both are growing faster than the rules that connect them.

item.title: What ‘dry powder’ means and why it moves markets
item.description: Why uncalled LP commitments act as both cushion and constraint across venture cycles.

item.title: How to read a funding announcement in 60 seconds
item.description: What headline numbers hide, how to read lead signals, and which claims deserve a second look.

item.title: Where startup money is flowing: a sector map
item.description: A structured map for reading capital across infrastructure, software, climate, defense, and health without guessing figures.
